LBS Interior Studio 0.1.0 is a standalone Android preview. Use it to configure a wardrobe, explore 18 Meraki finishes, and save and share a project specification.

Download the APK below on an ARM Android phone running Android 7.0 or later. Tap the downloaded file to install it. If Android prompts you, allow this installation from the browser or file manager you used. The app includes its JavaScript bundle and assets. Native room placement requires a supported phone and Google Play Services for AR. Physical-device AR tracking and scale are awaiting validation.

The APK has an LBS preview signing certificate. Its SHA-256 checksum is `3ab5670db7167801ba445dd06b22dea2162b3fec7984bc6a8ee8e13c502aa9a6`.
